eventAcceptance.scope: Actual read-only iCloud sports-calendar event through EventKit; native Mac private/named rendering, capacity, relaunch and disconnect.
eventAcceptance.reference: Apple Calendar showed a sports event on 13 October, 21:00–22:45. Taskfold rendered the same 105-minute interval. No source events or calendars were created, edited or deleted.
eventAcceptance.privacy: Titles off rendered Busy with no event title in the accessibility tree; titles on rendered the sports event name. Final build reversed it back to Busy.
eventAcceptance.relaunch: Normal native Quit verified process exit. No-argument final build relaunch retained selected calendar, titles on and 09:00–23:00 hours; returning to 13 October showed the same named event and 105-minute deduction.

titleFix.finding: The sheet navigationTitle leaked into the main Mac window after Save/Cancel until the next navigation update.
titleFix.change: On Mac, a persistent in-sheet header replaces navigationTitle. iOS retains its native navigation title in both owned source copies.
titleFix.nativeVerification: Final Mac sheet has visible Planner settings heading and AX heading trait. Both Cancel and Save immediately return to Calendar window title. Header and private event screenshots inspected.
titleFix.failedIteration: Principal toolbar item prevented the title leak but did not render a sheet heading. Replaced with safeAreaInset header before acceptance.
